visual_description: A large, tan-colored geodesic or frame tent made of heavy-duty ripstop canvas. It has reinforced tie-downs held by earth anchors. One flap is open, revealing a folding table inside with a laptop, field journals, and a small microscope. A solar power cable runs under the bottom edge.

constraints.material: Weather-beaten canvas; clear PVC window panels; heavy-duty zippers.
constraints.background: Positioned against a backdrop of stratified badlands, with sandbags lining the base for wind resistance.
